pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions during active price retracements; pyramiding is only authorized after a confirmed 1R profit break-even lock on the primary tranche.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorization unless the 5-minute ATR ratio confirms expansion and the orderbook imbalance exceeds a 2.5x delta threshold.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops when unrealized profit hits $10.00 to guarantee net wins fall strictly within the $15-$30+ target bracket.
